mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals a tightening labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of tightening labor markets (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increased housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals increased supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increased industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in easing monetary policy periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past month, it signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of robust demand (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a supply-side contraction under tight monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary conditions with supply contraction
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of supply contraction under tight monetary conditions (t-test p > 0.05).
